l10n.tokensInformation: Every week you’ll earn Tokens, as long as you gained any XP during that time. The higher your level, the more Tokens you’ll get. Use Tokens to enter for your chance to win the big Featured Rewards.
l10n.xpInformation: Earn Experience Points (XP) by completing Missions. A special Featured Mission is only available for a limited time. Other Missions may be available only once, or repeatable every week. Check each one for details.
l10n.hoverOnEachBadge: Show the world what you're made of! Drag and drop up to 5 Achievements to show at the top of your profile. Click the favorite icon to make one your user title.
l10n.dragDropBadges: Drag and drop individual badges to display in top badges
l10n.levelsInfo: The top GeForce gamers are Titanium. Are you? It's easy, just take on Missions to earn experience points (XP) that will level you up from Silver, to Gold, to Titanium. You get Perks right away as a Silver member, and as you progress, you'll get greater rewards. Every year is a new opportunity to level up; your level on 31st December 2017 will last through 2018.
l10n.redeemPerks: To redeem Perks, go to the "MY REWARDS" tab. Each Perk can only be redeemed once per graphics card.
